text: Describe a support flow in plain language and the Internal Agent configures the policies, knowledge and tools for it
quote: Describe the flow you want in natural language - the policies, knowledge, and tool connections it combines - and the Internal Agent configures it.

text: Simulate agent behavior against historical tickets or mock scenarios, and run production tests to verify tool connections before launch
quote: Simulations replay your historical tickets - or mock scenarios - against the configurations in the task, and production tests verify your tool connections.

text: Every agent action requires manual approval by default, with per-task/automation auto-approve overrides
quote: By default, every action requires manual approval. You can set specific tools to auto-approve per task or automation

text: Configuration changes publish as trackable releases that can be reverted with one click
quote: Configuration actions publish as a release on the Releases page, where you can track the impact and revert with one click.

text: Automations can run on a schedule (e.g. every weekday 9am) or be triggered by external events like a GitHub PR merge
quote: An automation is an Internal Agent task that runs on a schedule, like every weekday at 9am, or a trigger, like a GitHub PR merging

text: Set conditional approval rules, e.g. requiring Slack approval before a refund tool executes above a dollar threshold
quote: Require Slack approval before the refund tool runs on amounts above $100.

text: Automatically transfer tickets to the right human team with a summary note based on account type
quote: When a ticket is about an enterprise account, transfer it to the enterprise team with a summary note.

text: Enable auto-approve so the agent can perform any action through a connected tool without human sign-off
quote: Enable auto-approve for a task or automation, and the Internal Agent can perform any action through the connection without asking for approval.

text: View live knowledge base content and full version history, including who published what and a diff for every change
quote: See your live knowledge and its version history - who published what and when, with a diff for every change

text: Role-based access control across the product
quote: Role-based access across the product.

text: Workspace admins can disable all personal data storage/retention on the platform
quote: Workspace admins can disable all personal data storage in the platform if they do not want Parahelp to retain this data.

text: Tools can call any service with an API, whether a public integration like Stripe or an internal company endpoint
quote: Tools can use any service with an API: public integrations like Stripe, or your own internal endpoints.

text: Customer requests can be handled purely via API instead of going through a ticketing system, using the same configs and guardrails
quote: Customer requests come in through the API instead of a ticketing system. Your Customer Agent handles them with the same configurations, tools, and guardrails

text: Run the Internal Agent autonomously without approval waits, triggered from your own tools via API
quote: let the Internal Agent act without waiting for approval, and run it from your own tools via the API.

text: Customer Agent operates as a team member inside Intercom, Zendesk, Front, Plain, or Pylon
quote: Your Customer Agent works as a team member in Intercom, Zendesk, Front, Plain, or Pylon.

text: Pylon integration lets the agent resolve tickets across email, live chat, and Slack
quote: Parahelp now integrates with Pylon! ... their agents resolve tickets across email, live chat, and Slack

text: Automations can watch tools and the support queue and proactively surface gaps on their own
quote: Set up automations that watch your tools and your support queue and surface gaps on their own.

text: A tool connection is configured once and shared between both the Internal Agent and Customer Agent
quote: Connect a tool once, and both agents can use it

text: The Internal Agent analyzes your last 500-1000 resolved tickets plus existing context to auto-build the first version of your Customer Agent
quote: the Internal Agent analyzes your last 500-1,000 resolved tickets along with your existing context to build the first version of your Customer Agent

text: Anyone, not just engineers, can build new tools for the Customer Agent
quote: Anyone can build tools for the Customer Agent without waiting on engineering.
